description: This file contains serialization, surrogate, and copying logic for the ImmutableStack<T> type in Orleans.Serialization, including a serializer class, a surrogate struct, and a deep copier class.

classes.name: ImmutableStackCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for ImmutableStack<T> using surrogate serialization.

classes.name: ImmutableStackSurrogate<T>
classes.description: Surrogate type for serializing ImmutableStack<T> as a list of values.

classes.name: ImmutableStackCopier<T>
classes.description: Deep copier for ImmutableStack<T> supporting optional deep copying.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts surrogate data back into an ImmutableStack<T> by reversing the list of values.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts an ImmutableStack<T> into its surrogate form by copying its values into a list.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an ImmutableStack<T>, handling cyclic references and shallow copy optimization.
